tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bla ma zhi drag gi lo rgyus shin tu bsdus pa bzhugs so//

'phags pa bskal pa bzang po la sogs pa nas gsungs pa ltar// bskal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong 'byon par gsungs pa las/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa 'di la 'dren pa de nyid yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan nas lo bcu gnyis lon pa na/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyi mdzad phrin gcig tu bsdus pa'i rang gzugs ni/ chu bo chen po sindhu rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i mtsho gling chen por dri med padma'i sdong po'i sbubs su brdzus te mchog gi sprul pa'i skur bltams pa'i tshul mdzad pa la mtsho skyes rdo rje zhes grags| de nyid rgyal po ind+ra bhū tis spyan drangs nas sras kyi skal bar mdzad/ slar khrims bkral te/ khyim nas khyim med par nges par 'byung ba'i tshul gyis sdom pa gsum yang dag par bzhes te/ dur khrod chen po rnams su brtul zhugs kyi spyod pas rang don mthar phyin par chos sku phun*/sum tshogs pa mngon par byang chub pa rnam pa lngas 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan nas 'phags pa'i yul dang*/ bye brag yul gru tha dad pa rnams su log par 'dren pa'i 'jigs tshogs kyi lta ba la mngon par zhen pa rnams ye shes rdo rjes bcom ste rnam par dag pa'i lam du btsud pa dang*/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa dam pa 'dis kyang nyi zla ltar gsal bar mdzad pa'i rim pa ches mang la/ de'i tshe 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa bod chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis zan yang mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang chen po bzhengs pa'i tshe/ lha 'dre ma rungs pa rnams kyis tho 'tsham pa gang gis kyang ma thul ba'i tshe/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇa grub chen po rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu gcig pur gyur pa slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas spyan drangs pas rgyal po'i dgongs pa grub cing*/ bod yul du bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa ches cher gsal bar mdzad/

slar paṇa grub gzhan rnams 'phags pa'i yul sogs su log kyang*/ slob dpon chen po 'dis 'chims phu sogs bod kyi sgrub gnas dpag tu med pa zhabs kyis bcags| rtsod dus 'dir chos ltar bcos pa ltar snang ba dag gis 'gro ba bslu ba'i tshe sman par dgongs te/ rgyal ba'i gsung rab mdo sngags kyi chos 'khrul pa'i dri ma med pa rnams zab gter du bgrang gis mi lang ba sbas te phyis 'byung gi las dang skal par ldan pa rnams kyi don du smon lam btab/ de nas rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan mya ngan las 'das nas lha sras mu tig btsad pos rgyal po mdzad pa'i tshe sku dngos kyi gdul bya rdzogs nas/ lho nub srin po 'dul du gshegs pa'i tshe'ang bod 'bangs la thugs brtse ba'i phyir nangs re dgong re dang*/ tshes bcu'i tshe na mchod pa la/ las dag pa'i snang ngor sku dngos dang*/ gdul bya dman pa'i ngor sprul pa'i sku du mar ston par gsungs la/ de dag gi bla ma sgrub pa'i thabs du ma zhig zab gter du sbas pa las/ 'di ni gter ston chen po padma gling pas zab gter du bzhes pa'i lugs ltar yin gyi/ gzhan yang slob dpon chen po 'di ni yon tan gsum gyis bdag cag gi ston pa las lhag pa'i tshul dang*/ gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir bstan pa spel ba dang*/ 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po legs par mdzad pas bod 'bangs rnams la bka' drin gyi phung po gzhal du med pa kho na yin pa'i rnam par thar pa rnams ni padma bka' yi thang yig la sogs par ches cher rgyas par gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de ltar lam thams cad kyi snying po/ dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba 'ba' zhig tu gyur pa ni bla ma la gsol ba 'debs pa kho na yin pa rgyal bas gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dir bla ma zhi ba'i gtor dbang gi rim pa mdor bsdus pa'i brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug

/sprul pa'i sku mchog padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ lha lcam padma gsal/ gter ston padma gling pa/ grub chen tshe 'phel bzang po/ rgyal ba'i dbang po rin chen phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal po/ snyigs dus kyi 'dren mchog dharma rā dza sampānna maṅga la shrī bha dra/ de nyid kyi drung du bdag chos kyi grags pas mnos pa'o/// / ༈ /yang drag dmar nyang lugs kyi lo rgyus bsdus pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul bod chos skyong ba'i rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul nas slob dpon chen po padma saṃ bha wa la sogs pa paṇa grub mang po spyan drangs| chos 'khor dpal gyi bsam yas bzhengs pa'i tshe mnga' gsol rab gnas rnams grub par mdzad nas paṇa grub gzhan rnams rang yul du log /slob dpon chen po dang chos rgyal yon mchod gdan 'dzom par dpal gyi bsam yas nyid du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ rgyal po pe har lus ngag dul yang sems ma dul bas nyin re bzhin btsun pa'i gzugs kyis slob dpon la/ slob dpon chen po thugs gang la bred ces zhus pa'i tshe/ slob dpon gyis/ bdag 'khor 'das thams cad mnyam pa chen por rtogs pas gang la'ang 'jigs pa med do// zhes gsungs kyang snga ma ltar yang yang zhus pas lan gcig gi tshe/ slob dpon gyis bre mo'i tshul du kho bo ni sdig pa la cung zad 'jigs so/ zhes dge sdig gi go don la snyegs nas gsungs pas/ pe har gyi blo 'khrul pas srog chags sdig pa la bsam nas/ nyin gcig slob dpon bar khang g.yu zhal du bzhugs pa'i tshe/ sa g.yo ba dang*/ gnam sa 'khrugs pa/ 'ur sdig gi sgra 'brug stong ldir ba ltar byung bas/ slob dpon gyis pe har gyi bar gcod du mkhyen nas/ gtsug lag khang gi dkar bug nas gzigs pas sdig pa shin tu che zhing 'jigs pa kha mig dgu rwa bco brgyad dang ldan pa zhig gis has po ri rwa sprag tu bteg nas 'ong ba gzigs pas/

slob dpon dbang drag 'bar ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rol ba chen pos ri rab dang mnyam pa'i drag po mdog dmar me'i phreng ba can g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa phyar bas srid gsum brlag par byed pa zhig gi skur bzhengs nas/ pe har gyi rnam shes gnas spar te phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad drag po phrin las kyi rol pa chen por rgyal po pe har gyis brdzus pa'i sdig pa de nyid byin gyis brlabs te/ sdig pa de nyid kyi mjug ma nas phyag g.yon pas bzung ste rwa sprag tu pe har bcug pa'i mgor g.yas pa'i rdo rjes bsnun par brtsam pa na/ pe har gyis rang gi srog snying mdong gsol du phul nas khas blangs dam bcas te chos byed rnams kyi srung mar bskos so// de dag gi sgrub skor rnams mnga' bdag rgyal po dang mtsho rgyal la gtad pas mtsho rgyal gyis thebs su btab ste/ mnga' bdag gi sprul ba nyang ral pa can gyis 'don par smon lam btab nas phyi rabs kyi don du gter du sbas so// de dag gi brgyud pa ni/ chos sku snang ba mtha' yas/ longs sku spyan ras gzigs dbang*/ sprul sku padma 'byung gnas/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal/ chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan/ gter ston mnga' bdag nyang ral/ sras mi bskyod rdo rje/ grub thob me long ras pa/ bla ma sangs rgyas bkra shis/ bla ma dkon mchog bshes gnyen/ rtogs ldan kun dga' gzhon nu/ mkhas grub byams pa rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku yon tan bkra shis/ rgyal sras kun dga' 'o ma/ sngags 'chang zla ba 'od zer/ bla ma dga' ba'i mtshan can/ rje btsun gnam lcags me 'bar/ rgyal dbang chos rgyal phun tshogs// des bdag chos kyi grags pa la stsal ba'o// zhes pa ni gu ru zhi drag gi lo rgyus bsdus pa 'di yang blo dman 'ga' zhig gi don du/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ//
